context: Tests whether jpa-persistence, run directly for the Persistence layer before the service layer exists, creates the domain record and the outbound port the adapter implements in a hexagonal reactor, imitates the RoomType exemplar, marks the uniqueness check with the qualified business rule marker, and stops at its layer boundary with a Handover.

checklist.name: Domain record without framework imports
checklist.description: A Guest record exists in hotel-domain (e.g. com.example.hotel.domain.guest.Guest) with the entity model's fields and no jakarta.persistence, org.springframework, or Lombok import

checklist.name: Outbound port as a plain sibling interface
checklist.description: A GuestRepository interface is created in hotel-business in the guest feature package (next to where RoomTypeRepository sits for room types), not in a port subpackage, and its methods use the domain Guest type only, never an entity

checklist.name: Port offers what UC-020 needs and nothing speculative
checklist.description: The port has a save method and an email check (e.g. existsByEmail); it does not add unrelated methods such as delete or search that UC-020 does not call

checklist.name: Separate entity in the adapter module
checklist.description: GuestEntity is an @Entity in hotel-postgres (postgres.guest.model package) with explicit no-args constructor and getters, no Lombok, and its id generated from guest_seq

checklist.name: Sequence allocation matches the migration
checklist.description: The id mapping declares a @SequenceGenerator for guest_seq with allocationSize = 1, matching INCREMENT BY 1 in V2__create_guest.sql (not the default 50)

checklist.name: Spring Data repository, converters, and adapter imitate RoomType
checklist.description: GuestJpaRepository extends JpaRepository<GuestEntity, Long> in postgres.guest.query; hand-written static GuestConverter and GuestEntityConverter in postgres.guest.converter (no MapStruct); GuestRepositoryImpl annotated @Repository in postgres.guest implements the business GuestRepository port, and its save calls saveAndFlush so a unique-constraint violation surfaces inside the service method

checklist.name: Qualified business rule marker on the email check
checklist.description: The query method or adapter method that checks for an existing email carries the comment // UC-020 BR-001: directly above it

checklist.name: No migration written and no ddl-auto change
checklist.description: No new Flyway migration is created and V2__create_guest.sql is unchanged; spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is not set to update, create, or create-drop anywhere

checklist.name: Stops at the layer boundary
checklist.description: No GuestService, no GuestController, no DTO, no inbound port or use-case interface, and no test class is created

checklist.name: Markers table rows added
checklist.description: docs/architecture/development.md gains Markers rows for Persistence / jpa-persistence (Name and Code), the existing All row is kept, and no other file under docs/ is modified

checklist.name: Handover block for the service layer
checklist.description: The final report ends with a Handover from jpa-persistence (UC-020) block listing the Guest record, the GuestRepository port with its method signatures, the exception save raises for a duplicate email (DataIntegrityViolationException), and the files they live in, followed by 'Next: /spring-service UC-020'

checklist.name: Domain stays free of persistence code
checklist.description: Nothing added to hotel-domain or hotel-business imports jakarta.persistence or org.springframework.data
